purpose: Reviewed per-facility candidate exclusions at stacked or shared-collector junctions where geometric and topology heuristics cannot pin the right ramp. Each exclusion names the evidence that proves the candidate wrong. Global heuristics are deliberately avoided: the up-side Hatsudai entrance anchors onto a collector shared with Hatagaya hundreds of meters from the catalog point, so distance or way-ownership cuts sever real entrances.
